1531-1981-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

512-3443-7014.easyPrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-3443-7014.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
512-3443-7014.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Deathbloom Ritualist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3443-7014.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Deathbloom Ritualist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1339-1832-5231-7192.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-7192.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1531-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2464-3249-4556--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-4556--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-4556--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-6719--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1957-2530-6719--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-6972-8095--112.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
911-6972-8095--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1978-4832-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.

4399-4770-6626-6823.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6626-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3263-5641-6824-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3263-5641-6824-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7768.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-2074-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-2074-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7511.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
6798-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2034-5003-7485.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Essenceknit Scholar, adding {C}{C}.
When Essenceknit Scholar dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Essenceknit Scholar from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Essenceknit Scholar enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1734-2034-5987.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5170-6132-6634.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-4785-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-2800-5702-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2800-5702-7060.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-3899-4365-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-2593-3789.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

2867-3866-4050.description:
Cast Abhorrent Overlord by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Abhorrent Overlord enters, it triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Harpy creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Abhorrent Overlord and two Harpy tokens, adding {2}{B}.
When the creatures die, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers three times, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Demon of Dark Schemes by paying {2}{B} and {E}{E}{E}{E}, putting Abhorrent Overlord from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-1322-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1789-2292-4452-5649.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2292-4452-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1365-4853-5256-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4853-5256-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Arsenal Thresher's power.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-1849-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4885-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

796-2440-3923-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Zombie.
796-2440-3923-4050.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Zombie you control.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and returning Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {U}.
Repeat.
If you control two or more Zombies as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

474-4615-5256.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Specimen Collector.
When the Specimen Collector token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the nontoken Specimen Collector.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a token copy of the Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing any number of players to mill infinite cards.

1620-4067-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least five.
1620-4067-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Bestial Bloodline, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Bestial Bloodline by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If your devotion to green is at least six, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may untap any other permanent(s) using Mind over Matter.

97-560-2034-2308.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
97-560-2034-2308.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing another Beast, causing you to gain 4 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

328-2136.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
328-2136.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
Each Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

4089-5011-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Glasspool Mimic's power.
Repeat.

1446-2060-4549-4659-4680.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1446-2060-4549-4659-4680.description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping The Hollow Sentinel, adding {1}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

401-1402-4924-5295.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-1402-4924-5295.description:
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1}, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1678-4508-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
1678-4508-4875.description:
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

930-1789-2232-4050.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, triggering Lathliss, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Universal Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

95-1848.description: Declare Fleet Swallower as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing an opponent to mill their library due to Bruvac.
95-1848.notes: If desired, Fleet Swallower can target you to mill half your library instead.
